# Spiking_Network_Topology_Analysis

**Domain**: iNEST

## Definition
The systematic examination of connectivity patterns within spiking neural networks to understand how topology influences spike propagation and information encoding. Enables design of more efficient neuromorphic hardware by optimizing network structure for desired computational behaviors.
